filter.description: Filters are `key:value` terms separated by commas (e.g. `period:this_year,state:all`). Any filter you pass replaces the defaults below entirely, so include every key you need. Available filters: | **Filter** | **Type** | **Default** | **Description** | | - | - | - | - | | state | `String` | `all` | `all`, `draft`, `open`, `scheduled`, `pending_payment`, `late`, `reminded`, `paid` or `uncollectible` | | period | `String` | `this_year` | Matches on the invoice date. A period description (`this_week`, `prev_week`, `next_week`, `this_month`, `prev_month`, `next_month`, `this_quarter`, `prev_quarter`, `next_quarter`, `this_year`, `prev_year`, `next_year`) or a custom period (`201301..201302`, `20130101..20130131`). A custom period must have a start and an end date. It must not be longer than 10 years. For one month, use `202401..202401`, not `202401`. Without `period`, the filter does not limit the dates. The default `this_year` applies only when you send no `filter`. | | reference | `String` | | Select invoices with a certain reference | | contact_id | `Integer` | | Select invoices belonging to a certain contact | | recurring_sales_invoice_id | `Integer` | | Select invoices created by a certain recurring invoice | | workflow_id | `Integer` | | Select invoices that use a certain workflow | | created_after | `String` | | Select invoices created after the given time (exclusive). ISO 8601 formatted string. The time to compare with is in UTC timezone | | updated_after | `String` | | Select invoices updated after the given time (exclusive). ISO 8601 formatted string. The time to compare with is in UTC timezone | The `period` filter matches on the invoice date. It does not look at the `period` of the individual details, which says which months the expenses belong to. Read `details[].period` in the response when you need those months, or use the reports endpoints, which already spread the amounts over that period. A detail's period can fall outside the filtered range, however wide you make it, so this filter cannot tell you which periods amounts fall in. Use the reports endpoints for that. automated_tax_enabled.description: Whether automatic tax calculation is enabled for this detail. When enabled, the tax rate is automatically determined based on the product's type and VAT rate type, combined with the contact's country, tax number and address. Requires a `product_id` with smart tax selection enabled (i.e. `product_type` and `vat_rate_type` configured on the product).

user_id.description: The user who created the download

download_type.description: The type of download (e.g., export_contacts, export_sales_invoices, auditfile)

entity_type.description: The type of the record the event is about, for example `Contact`, `SalesInvoice` or `Document`. Purchase invoices, receipts and the other document types are `Document`.

entity_id.description: The record the event is about. Empty when that record was deleted.

data.description: Details of the event. For an update, the changed attributes are `[old_value, new_value]` pairs.

moneybird_account.description: Whether Moneybird provides this account (Moneybird Betaalrekening or Moneybird Online Betaalmethoden), rather than an account at an external bank or provider.

id.description: The ID of an existing fiscal allocation to update. Required when updating or removing an existing allocation; omit when creating a new one.

ledger_account_id.description: The ID of the ledger account (category) this allocation applies to. Must match a ledger account used in the document's details.

private_ledger_account_id.description: The ID of the private ledger account (equity account) to allocate the private portion to.

percentage.description: The percentage of expenses for the given ledger account that is allocated to private use. The total percentage across all allocations for the same ledger account on a document must not exceed 100.

value.description: The value for this ledger account

money.description: An amount of money. Both a decimal and a string '10,95' are accepted. A string is bound to the same range as a number, -1,000,000,000 <= *n* <= 1,000,000,000.

operating_profit.description: `gross_profit` minus the total of `expenses_by_ledger_account`, so excluding other income and expenses

date.description: The date of the record itself. It does not say which periods the amounts belong to, because a detail can carry its own `period` and a record dated in one month can cover another. period.description: ISO 8601 duration string (e.g. "P1M" for one month, "P3M" for one quarter, "P1Y" for one year)

deadline_after.description: ISO 8601 duration string representing the deadline offset from the period end

enabled_events.description: List of events this webhook is subscribed to. See [webhook events](https://developer.moneybird.com/webhooks/events) for all available events and event groups.

last_http_status.description: HTTP status code of the request last received back from the webhook

last_http_body.description: Body of the request last received back from the webhook

secret.description: The webhook's secret, used to generate webhook signatures. Only returned at creation.

deactivated_at.description: Timestamp when the webhook was deactivated. Null if the webhook is active.

bank.description: The balance of the financial accounts, or zero when that balance is negative

to_pay.description: The current liabilities, including a negative balance of the financial accounts
